## 维护者速读(席位终稿 · Head-sha: fcf9e05cbe · 2026-11-17T22:45Z)

- 改了什么：审批技能的「分支与副作用」一节加一条：审批通过/驳回分支上，如果某一步的写入可能被钩子、校验规则或权限拒绝，就从这一步画一条 `fault` 边到处理节点，拒绝走 fault 分支，审批照常返回;不画的话,`POST …/approve`(或 `/reject`)返回 `500 RESUME_FAILED`,审批决定已生效、流程卡住，响应体带 `innerRefusal` 和给审批人看的 `userMessage`。配一条评测用例(单独新文件)。
- 为什么改:#34579 已让决策门带回拒绝原因，但技能没教画 fault 边，AI 写出的审批流程被钩子拒绝时照样卡住。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文本和评测，不改运行代码;为不超 token 上限删了同文件四处重复表述，席位已核这些内容在同文件示例里仍在。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` 「Branching, side-effects and rejection」一节新增的那条。
- 两分钟验证：读那一条：应写明画 fault 边、否则 500 `RESUME_FAILED`、决定已生效、体内有 `innerRefusal` 与 `userMessage`。
- 需要你做的：批准本 PR(受管面 Tier H);批准前还欠一次契约审核(L2)。

席位意见：建议批准。「500」开发对照了合并代码(`packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts`,`rest-approvals-wire-codes.test.ts` 钉住)与所引裁决(#13807 评论 5541861039,2026-09-04 批次 #37 方案 1B);只教已合并的决策门，未合并的 #34638(撤回门的 `resumeFailure`)不教。

## 席位核对 · L1 ACCEPT · Head-sha: fcf9e05cbe

Card #34637, claim 6959148889, dev report 6963150096. The seat read the diff itself.

| Item | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| Shape | Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #34637`; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. Three files: the reference (+7 −11), a new eval file `approval-fault-edge.json`, and a `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset. Governed (`skills/**`), Tier H. |
| Accuracy | The 500 and the body members were verified by the dev against the merged route and its wire-code pin, and the ruling is quoted in the PR body. The bullet teaches only the decision doors' thrown `RESUME_FAILED`. The `resumeFailure` pair (#34638, PR #34999, not merged) is not taught: scope fence held. |
| Removed text | Four restatements were cut to fit the ratchet (headroom 0 → 3 tokens, no ceiling moved). The seat checked each still stands on this head: send-back is the "Send-back for revision (ADR-0044)" section (line 142); the conditional step is the example's `needs_director` decision node and edge conditions; the hard reject is the example's `reject` edges into `end` nodes (`e3`); the text diagram is the section's three numbered pieces. |
| Evals | One case, in its own file: the dev moved it off `flows-triggers-approvals.json` after an overlap with PR #34793 (that file is byte-identical to main now). It was hand-replicated through the runner's argv: with the skill 3 / 3, without 0 / 2. The token list was settled after reading those answers, so this is not an independent test (noted by the dev). |
| Gates | 45 of 47 derived families exit 0, token ratchet among them. 2 are NOT MEASURED (whole-build prerequisites; no package source changed), CI-owned. Overlap clean. |
| Landing | Governed (Tier H): the maintainer approves. Owed first: a contract-review-tier L2 record and every check green. |
